proposal.name: SHAP Interaction Value Feature Pair Engineering (Cat52)
proposal.description: Run SHAP TreeExplainer with interaction_values=True on S15's best random_forest model (79f, Brier 0.22159). Compute N×N SHAP interaction matrix. Extract top-20 feature pairs by mean |SHAP_interaction|. Encode each pair as a product/ratio feature and add to Cat52 of the feature engine. GA can then select/deselect these engineered interaction terms.
implementation_steps: STEP 1 (Kaggle Karpathy): Load S15 best model + X_test. Run: explainer = shap.TreeExplainer(model); shap_int = explainer.shap_interaction_values(X_test). Shape: (n_samples, n_features, n_features).
STEP 2: Aggregate: mean_int = np.abs(shap_int).mean(axis=0). Zero diagonal. Extract top-20 off-diagonal pairs (i,j) with highest mean_int[i,j].
STEP 3: For each pair (feat_i, feat_j), add to feature engine: feat_i × feat_j (product), abs(feat_i - feat_j) (abs difference) — 2 features per pair = 40 new features total.
STEP 4: Add as Cat52_ShapInteractions to features/engine.py. Label each with pair metadata for interpretability.
STEP 5: Push updated engine.py to hf-space. GA will naturally select/prune via feature count penalty in fitness.

proposal.why_now: S15 fleet leader (RF 79f Brier 0.22159, ROI 30.67%) is the ideal model for SHAP interaction analysis — random forests have well-calibrated SHAP values. Checkpoint threshold 0.21837, gap 0.00322. Adding 40 interaction features from top-20 SHAP pairs gives GA new levers to close gap. Previous SHAP proposal (March 29) was about seeding GA init — this is about feature ENGINEERING from interaction matrix, orthogonal approach.
proposal.cpu_constraints: Analysis runs on Kaggle GPU. Resulting features are scalar arithmetic (products, differences) — CPU compatible on all 6 islands. Zero inference overhead.
proposal.cross_project: Identical pattern applicable to nomos-political-alpha Cat14_ShapInteractions once validated on NBA. Political interaction pairs (donor_amount × sector_heat, polymarket_delta × elo_diff) could uncover regime-switching dynamics.
